reference_standard: Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP 2022, 9th Ed) & National Formulary of India (NFI) / NLEM 2022

entries.ip_title: Paracetamol IP / Paracetamol Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take after meals with water. Minimum 4-6 hours between doses.
entries.max_daily_dose: 4000 mg/24h in adults (2000 mg/24h in severe hepatic/chronic alcohol use)
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 10-50 mL/min: dose q6h; CrCl < 10 mL/min: dose q8h
contraindications: Severe active hepatic impairment or acute liver failure

entries.ip_title: Ibuprofen IP / Ibuprofen Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take strictly after meals with water. Do not lie down for 15 minutes after swallowing.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Avoid in severe renal impairment (eGFR < 30 mL/min)
contraindications: Active peptic ulcer disease or GI bleeding
entries.pregnancy_category: Avoid in 3rd trimester (premature closure of ductus arteriosus)

entries.ip_title: Diclofenac Sodium IP / Diclofenac Gastro-resistant Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take after meals. Inject deep intragluteal if IM.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Avoid if CrCl < 30 mL/min; use lowest effective dose
contraindications: Ischemic heart disease, peripheral arterial disease, cerebrovascular disease

entries.ip_title: Tramadol Hydrochloride IP / Tramadol Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: May cause dizziness or drowsiness. Avoid driving. Infuse IV slowly over 2-3 minutes.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl < 30 mL/min: maximum 200 mg/day, dosing interval q12h
contraindications: Acute intoxication with alcohol or sedatives

entries.ip_title: Morphine Sulphate IP / Morphine Tablets IP / Morphine Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Monitor respiratory rate, sedation score, and pupillary constriction. Co-prescribe laxative (senna/lactulose) for opioid bowel dysfunction.
entries.max_daily_dose: Titrated to pain relief and tolerability (no ceiling in cancer palliative care)
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl < 50 mL/min: reduce dose by 25-50% and extend interval (active metabolite M6G accumulates)

entries.ip_title: Fentanyl Citrate IP / Fentanyl Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Potent synthetic opioid (100x morphine). Slow IV injection over 1-2 min (prevents wooden chest / chest wall rigidity).
entries.max_daily_dose: Titrated to sedation/analgesia targets under mechanical ventilation
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Safe in renal failure (hepatic metabolism to inactive norfentanyl)

entries.ip_title: Amoxicillin and Potassium Clavulanate Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take at the start of a meal to enhance absorption and minimize GI intolerance.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 10-30 mL/min: 625mg q12h; CrCl < 10 mL/min: 625mg q24h
contraindications: History of penicillin or beta-lactam anaphylaxis
History of amoxicillin-clavulanate-associated jaundice or hepatic dysfunction
entries.pregnancy_category: B (Generally safe; avoid routinely in preterm rupture of membranes)

entries.ip_title: Amoxicillin IP / Amoxicillin Capsules IP
entries.default_instructions: Take with water. Complete full course even if fever resolves.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 10-30 mL/min: 250-500mg q12h; CrCl < 10 mL/min: 250-500mg q24h
contraindications: Infectious mononucleosis (high incidence of erythematous maculopapular rash)

entries.ip_title: Azithromycin IP / Azithromycin Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take 1 hour before or 2 hours after meals with a glass of water.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment required for mild-to-moderate impairment; caution if CrCl < 10 mL/min
contraindications: History of cholestatic jaundice with prior azithromycin
Congenital long QT syndrome or baseline QTc > 500ms

entries.ip_title: Ceftriaxone Sodium IP / Ceftriaxone Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Reconstitute with sterile water. Infuse IV over 30 minutes. NEVER co-administer with calcium-containing IV solutions (Ringer Lactate) in same line.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment needed unless both severe renal AND hepatic impairment coexist (max 2 g/day)
contraindications: Severe hypersensitivity (anaphylaxis) to cephalosporins or beta-lactams

entries.ip_title: Cefixime IP / Cefixime Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take with or without food. Complete course for typhoid or uncomplicated UTI.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 20-40 mL/min: 200mg OD; CrCl < 20 mL/min: 100mg OD

entries.ip_title: Piperacillin and Tazobactam Injection IP
entries.default_frequency: q6h or q8h (Extended infusion over 3-4 hours)
entries.default_instructions: Dilute in 100mL 0.9% Normal Saline. First dose STAT within 1 hour in severe sepsis.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 20-40 mL/min: 3.375g q6h; CrCl < 20 mL/min: 2.25g q6h; Hemodialysis: 2.25g q8h + 0.75g post-dialysis
contraindications: History of severe allergic reactions to penicillins, cephalosporins, or beta-lactamase inhibitors

entries.ip_title: Meropenem IP / Meropenem Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Infuse IV over 15-30 minutes, or extended infusion over 3 hours.
entries.max_daily_dose: 6 g/24h (in bacterial meningitis or severe Pseudomonas infections)
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 26-50 mL/min: 1g q12h; CrCl 10-25 mL/min: 500mg q12h; CrCl < 10 mL/min: 500mg q24h
contraindications: Severe hypersensitivity to carbapenems or immediate-type hypersensitivity to other beta-lactams

entries.ip_title: Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride IP / Ciprofloxacin Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take with full glass of water. Avoid antacids or milk within 2 hours. Warn patient to report tendon pain immediately.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 30-50 mL/min: 250-500mg q12h; CrCl < 30 mL/min: 250-500mg q18h
contraindications: History of fluoroquinolone-induced tendonitis or tendon rupture
entries.pregnancy_category: C (Avoid in pregnancy and pediatric patients unless no safe alternatives)

entries.ip_title: Levofloxacin IP / Levofloxacin Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Drink plenty of fluids. Take 2 hours before or after antacids / multivitamins containing iron or zinc.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 20-49 mL/min: initial 500mg then 250mg q24h; CrCl < 20 mL/min: initial 500mg then 250mg q48h

entries.ip_title: Doxycycline Hyclate IP / Doxycycline Capsules IP
entries.default_instructions: Take with a full glass of water sitting upright. Do not lie down for 30 minutes (prevents pill esophagitis). Avoid direct sun exposure.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment required in renal failure (eliminated primarily via non-renal GI pathways)
contraindications: Second and third trimesters of pregnancy
Children under 8 years of age (tooth discoloration and enamel hypoplasia)

entries.ip_title: Metronidazole IP / Metronidazole Tablets IP / Metronidazole Injection IP
entries.default_dose: 400 mg PO TDS / 500 mg IV q8h
entries.default_instructions: Take after meals. STRICTLY avoid alcohol during and for 48 hours after treatment (causes severe disulfiram-like reaction). Metallic taste is common.
entries.max_daily_dose: 2000 mg/24h oral, 4000 mg/24h IV in severe anaerobic infection
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl < 10 mL/min: reduce dose by 50%; hemodialysis removes drug (supplement post-dialysis)

entries.ip_title: Amikacin Sulphate IP / Amikacin Injection IP
entries.default_dose: 15 mg/kg OD (Once-daily aminoglycoside dosing) or 500 mg BD
entries.default_instructions: Dilute in 100mL NS and infuse over 30-60 minutes. Monitor serum creatinine and urine output. Perform baseline audiometry if prolonged therapy.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 50-80 mL/min: q24-36h; CrCl 30-50 mL/min: q48h; monitor trough levels (< 4-5 mcg/mL)
contraindications: Concurrent nephrotoxic/ototoxic agents (colistin, vancomycin) without TDM
entries.pregnancy_category: D (Risk of congenital eighth cranial nerve damage)

entries.ip_title: Amlodipine Besilate IP / Amlodipine Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take once daily in the morning with or without food. Monitor for ankle swelling / pedal edema.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment required in renal impairment

entries.ip_title: Telmisartan IP / Telmisartan Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take at the same time each day. Monitor serum potassium and creatinine within 2-4 weeks of initiation.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No starting dose adjustment in mild-to-moderate impairment; caution in severe impairment or bilateral renal artery stenosis
contraindications: Pregnancy (2nd and 3rd trimesters: fetotoxicity and oligohydramnios)
Severe hepatic impairment or biliary obstruction

entries.ip_title: Ramipril IP / Ramipril Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take at bedtime or morning. Report persistent dry cough or swelling of lips/tongue immediately.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl < 40 mL/min: initial dose 1.25 mg daily; titrate cautiously to max 5 mg daily

entries.ip_title: Metoprolol Succinate Prolonged-release Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take with or immediately after a meal. Swallow whole. Check resting heart rate before dosing; hold if HR < 55 bpm.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment required in renal impairment
contraindications: Second or third-degree AV block without pacemaker

entries.ip_title: Atorvastatin Calcium IP / Atorvastatin Tablets IP
entries.default_dose: 20 mg - 40 mg (80 mg STAT in acute ACS)
entries.default_instructions: Take at bedtime with or without food. Report unexplained muscle aches or dark urine immediately.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment required in renal impairment
contraindications: Active liver disease or unexplained persistent elevation of transaminases (> 3x ULN)

entries.ip_title: Rosuvastatin Calcium IP / Rosuvastatin Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take once daily with or without food at bedtime. High potency statin.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl < 30 mL/min: initial 5mg daily; max 10mg daily

entries.ip_title: Aspirin IP / Gastro-resistant Aspirin Tablets IP
entries.default_dose: 75 mg (325 mg chewable STAT in acute MI/chest pain)
entries.default_instructions: Take after meals with water. Chew STAT loading dose in acute chest pain for rapid antiplatelet action.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Avoid in severe renal failure (CrCl < 10 mL/min)
contraindications: Children < 16 years with viral fever (Reye syndrome)
entries.pregnancy_category: D (Low-dose 75-150mg used selectively for preeclampsia prevention under obstetric protocol)

entries.ip_title: Clopidogrel Bisulfate IP / Clopidogrel Tablets IP
entries.default_dose: 75 mg (300 mg STAT loading in acute coronary syndrome)
entries.default_instructions: Take once daily with or without food. Avoid omeprazole co-administration (prefer pantoprazole to avoid CYP2C19 inhibition).
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment required in renal impairment
contraindications: Active pathological bleeding (peptic ulcer or intracranial hemorrhage)

entries.ip_title: Furosemide IP / Furosemide Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Take in morning to prevent nocturia. Monitor serum potassium, sodium, and daily urine output / fluid balance.
entries.max_daily_dose: 600 mg/24h in refractory acute fluid overload
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Higher doses may be required in oliguric renal failure to achieve diuresis

entries.ip_title: Spironolactone IP / Spironolactone Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist for heart failure and resistant hypertension. Monitor potassium (hold if K+ > 5.0 mEq/L).
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: eGFR 30-50 mL/min: 12.5-25mg q48h; eGFR < 30 mL/min: CONTRAINDICATED (hyperkalemia)

entries.ip_title: Glyceryl Trinitrate Tablets IP / Glyceryl Trinitrate Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Dissolve under the tongue at onset of angina while seated. If pain persists after 3 doses in 15 min, seek immediate emergency care.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment required
contraindications: Concurrent PDE-5 inhibitors (sildenafil within 24h, tadalafil within 48h)

entries.ip_title: Pantoprazole Sodium IP / Pantoprazole Gastro-resistant Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast with a glass of water. Swallow whole; do not chew or crush.
entries.max_daily_dose: 80 mg/24h (80 mg IV bolus followed by 8 mg/hr infusion in acute upper GI bleed)
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment required in renal impairment

entries.ip_title: Omeprazole IP / Omeprazole Capsules IP
entries.default_instructions: Take 30 minutes before breakfast on empty stomach.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment required

entries.ip_title: Ondansetron Hydrochloride IP / Ondansetron Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take 30 minutes before meals or chemotherapy. MD tablet dissolves rapidly on tongue without water.
entries.max_daily_dose: 16 mg IV single dose, 24 mg/24h oral
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment required; in severe hepatic impairment max 8 mg/24h

entries.ip_title: Metoclopramide Hydrochloride IP / Metoclopramide Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Take 30 minutes before meals. Warn patient regarding extrapyramidal symptoms / dystonia (treat with IV promethazine).
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 15-60 mL/min: reduce dose by 50%; CrCl < 15 mL/min: reduce dose by 75%

entries.ip_title: Metformin Hydrochloride IP / Metformin Prolonged-release Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take with or immediately after meals to reduce GI side effects. Swallow prolonged release tablets whole.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: eGFR 45-59 mL/min: max 1000 mg/day; eGFR 30-44 mL/min: max 500 mg/day; eGFR < 30 mL/min: CONTRAINDICATED (lactic acidosis risk)
contraindications: Severe hypoxia, sepsis, acute heart failure
Hold 48h before and after iodinated radiocontrast
entries.pregnancy_category: B (Often used under specialist endocrinology protocol in GDM)

entries.ip_title: Glimepiride IP / Glimepiride Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take immediately before first substantial meal of the day. Educate on hypoglycemia signs (shakiness, diaphoresis, hunger) and keep sweets at hand.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Initial 1 mg daily; titrate conservatively; avoid in severe renal failure

entries.ip_title: Human Insulin Injection IP (Soluble / Regular)
entries.default_instructions: Inject subcutaneously 30 minutes before meals. Rotate injection sites across abdomen and thighs. Only form suitable for IV infusion in DKA.
entries.max_daily_dose: Individualized based on blood glucose and weight
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Insulin clearance decreases in renal failure; reduce dose and monitor CBG closely
contraindications: Known systemic hypersensitivity to human insulin
entries.pregnancy_category: B (Gold standard for glycemic control in pregnancy)

entries.ip_title: Insulin Glargine Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Peakless 24-hour basal insulin. Inject SC strictly at the same time each day. NEVER inject IV or mix in same syringe with other insulins.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Titrate to fasting blood sugar; requirements fall with declining renal function

entries.ip_title: Salbutamol Sulphate IP / Salbutamol Inhalation IP
entries.default_dose: 1-2 puffs (100-200 mcg) MDI or 2.5 mg Nebulized STAT
entries.default_duration: As needed for acute wheeze / bronchospasm
entries.default_instructions: Shake inhaler well. Use spacer device if possible. Inhale slowly and hold breath for 10 seconds.
entries.max_daily_dose: 800 mcg/24h via inhaler (or frequent nebulization under telemetry in ICU)
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment required
contraindications: Caution in severe tachyarrhythmias or thyrotoxicosis
entries.pregnancy_category: C (Drug of choice for acute asthma rescue in pregnancy)

entries.ip_title: Budesonide IP / Budesonide Inhalation Suspension IP
entries.default_instructions: Rinse mouth and gargle with water without swallowing after each inhalation (prevents oral candidiasis).
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment required
contraindications: Status asthmaticus primary therapy (requires systemic corticosteroids)
Untreated fungal or viral respiratory infections

entries.ip_title: Ipratropium Bromide IP / Ipratropium Inhalation Solution IP
entries.default_instructions: Anticholinergic bronchodilator. Protect eyes from nebulizer mist (prevents acute narrow angle glaucoma).
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment required

entries.ip_title: Montelukast Sodium IP / Montelukast Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take at night. Warn patient and family regarding neuropsychiatric events (nightmares, agitation, mood changes).
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment required
contraindications: Acute asthma attack / status asthmaticus rescue (not a bronchodilator)

entries.ip_title: Sodium Chloride Injection IP (0.9% w/v)
entries.therapeutic_category: Solutions Correcting Water, Electrolyte Disturbances and Acid-Base
entries.default_dose: 500 mL - 1000 mL (30 mL/kg in septic shock)
entries.default_instructions: Check bag clarity before hanging. Monitor lung bases for crepitations and JVP to prevent pulmonary edema.
entries.max_daily_dose: Titrated to mean arterial pressure (MAP >= 65 mmHg) and urine output
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Use with caution in oliguric renal failure and congestive heart failure

entries.ip_title: Compound Sodium Lactate Injection IP (Ringer Lactate)
entries.therapeutic_category: Solutions Correcting Water, Electrolyte Disturbances and Acid-Base
entries.default_instructions: Balanced crystalloid solution. NEVER administer via same infusion line as Ceftriaxone (calcium-ceftriaxone precipitation).
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Caution in severe renal failure with hyperkalemia (contains 4 mEq/L K+)
contraindications: Severe lactic acidosis or hepatic failure (impaired lactate metabolism)

entries.ip_title: Noradrenaline Bitartrate Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Dilute 4 mg in 50 mL D5W or NS (80 mcg/mL). Infuse exclusively via Central Venous Catheter with automated syringe pump. Target MAP >= 65 mmHg.
entries.max_daily_dose: Titrated to hemodynamic target (wean as shock resolves)
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment; restores renal perfusion in septic shock
contraindications: Hypovolemic shock prior to adequate fluid resuscitation (except as emergency bridge)

entries.ip_title: Adrenaline Injection IP (1:1000, 1 mg/mL)
entries.default_frequency: STAT (q5-15 min PRN in anaphylaxis; q3-5 min in CPR)
entries.default_instructions: ANAPHYLAXIS: Inject 0.5 mg (0.5 mL of 1:1000) IM into anterolateral thigh immediately. CARDIAC ARREST: 1 mg IV push followed by 20 mL flush.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment
contraindications: No absolute contraindications in cardiac arrest or severe anaphylaxis

entries.ip_title: Atropine Sulphate Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Give rapid IV push. Doses < 0.5 mg may cause paradoxical bradycardia. In organophosphate poisoning, titrate until full atropinization (clear chest, HR > 80, dry axillae).
entries.max_daily_dose: 3 mg (bradycardia); no ceiling in organophosphate poisoning
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment

entries.ip_title: Lorazepam IP / Lorazepam Tablets IP / Lorazepam Injection IP
entries.default_dose: 2 mg - 4 mg IV (Status epilepticus) / 1 mg PO
entries.default_instructions: First-line IV drug of choice in status epilepticus. Give slow IV over 2 minutes. Monitor airway and oxygen saturation.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Safe in renal failure (inactive glucuronide metabolite)

entries.ip_title: Phenytoin Sodium IP / Phenytoin Tablets IP / Phenytoin Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Dilute loading dose ONLY in 0.9% Normal Saline (precipitates in dextrose). Infusion rate MUST NOT exceed 50 mg/min (causes cardiac arrhythmias and hypotension). Monitor ECG.
entries.max_daily_dose: Titrated to therapeutic serum drug level (10-20 mcg/mL)
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Protein binding decreases in uremia; interpret free phenytoin level
contraindications: Sinus bradycardia, sino-atrial block, second- and third-degree AV block

entries.ip_title: Sodium Valproate IP / Valproate Gastro-resistant Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take with meals. Check baseline liver function tests and platelets. Highly teratogenic (avoid in women of childbearing potential).
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment needed, but monitor free valproic acid
contraindications: Severe active hepatic disease or familial history of severe hepatic dysfunction
Pregnancy (unless no alternative in severe epilepsy)
entries.pregnancy_category: X (Neural tube defects, facial dysmorphism, cognitive impairment)

entries.ip_title: Enoxaparin Sodium Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Inject SC into anterolateral abdominal wall. Do not expel air bubble from prefilled syringe before injection.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl < 30 mL/min: reduce to 20 mg OD for prophylaxis, or 1 mg/kg OD for treatment

entries.ip_title: Heparin Sodium Injection IP
entries.default_dose: 5000 IU IV STAT, then 1000-1200 IU/hr IV infusion
entries.default_instructions: Titrate to target aPTT 1.5 - 2.5 times control. Antidote is Protamine Sulfate (1 mg neutralizes 100 IU heparin).
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Safe in renal failure (eliminated via reticuloendothelial system)
entries.pregnancy_category: C (Does not cross placenta; safe in pregnancy)

entries.ip_title: Fluconazole IP / Fluconazole Capsules IP / Fluconazole Injection IP
entries.default_dose: 150 mg single dose (Vaginal candidiasis) / 200-400 mg OD (Systemic)
entries.default_instructions: Take with or without food. Complete course for fungal infection.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 21-50 mL/min: reduce dose by 50%; CrCl <= 20 mL/min: reduce dose by 75%
contraindications: Co-administration with terfenadine, cisapride, or astemizole
entries.pregnancy_category: D (Avoid except in life-threatening systemic fungal infections)

entries.ip_title: Artesunate IP / Artesunate Injection IP
entries.default_dose: 2.4 mg/kg IV at 0, 12, 24 hours then OD
entries.default_duration: Minimum 3 doses until patient can tolerate oral ACT
entries.default_instructions: First-line drug of choice for severe falciparum malaria in India (NVBDCP guidelines). Reconstitute with 5% sodium bicarbonate then dilute in 5mL NS. Follow with full 3-day oral ACT course.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment required in renal failure or hemodialysis
entries.pregnancy_category: Safe and life-saving in all trimesters of pregnancy for severe malaria (WHO/NVBDCP)

entries.ip_title: Rifampicin IP / Rifampicin Capsules IP
entries.default_instructions: Take in the morning 30 minutes before breakfast. Counsel patient that urine, sweat, saliva, and tears will turn orange-red (harmless). Potent CYP3A4 inducer.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment needed in renal failure; caution in liver disease
entries.pregnancy_category: C (Standard first-line anti-TB component in pregnancy)

entries.ip_title: Isoniazid IP / Isoniazid Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take on empty stomach. ALWAYS co-prescribe Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6) 10-25 mg/day to prevent peripheral neuropathy.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl < 10 mL/min: reduce dose to 200 mg/day; hemodialysis removes INH (dose post-dialysis)
contraindications: Acute liver disease or previous INH-associated hepatitis
entries.pregnancy_category: C (Safe and mandatory in active tuberculosis in pregnancy)

entries.ip_title: Dexamethasone Sodium Phosphate IP / Dexamethasone Tablets IP / Injection IP
entries.default_dose: 4 mg - 8 mg IV/PO OD or BD
entries.default_instructions: Potent long-acting glucocorticoid with minimal mineralocorticoid effect. Preferred in cerebral edema and fetal lung maturation in preterm labor. Monitor blood glucose closely.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No dose adjustment required
contraindications: Live viral vaccines during high-dose immunosuppressive therapy
entries.pregnancy_category: C (Crosses placenta; drug of choice for antenatal fetal lung maturation at 24-34 weeks)

entries.ip_title: Prednisolone IP / Prednisolone Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take single morning dose with breakfast to mimic physiological diurnal cortisol peak. Do not stop abruptly if taking for more than 2 weeks.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment required
entries.pregnancy_category: C (Extensively metabolized by placental 11-beta-HSD2; minimal fetal transfer)

entries.ip_title: Hydrocortisone Sodium Succinate Injection IP
entries.default_instructions: Short-acting glucocorticoid with mineralocorticoid activity. Indicated in acute adrenal insufficiency / addisonian crisis, refractory septic shock, and severe acute asthma.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment required

entries.ip_title: Cetirizine Hydrochloride IP / Cetirizine Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take at night. May cause mild drowsiness. Avoid alcohol.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 30-49 mL/min: 5mg OD; CrCl 10-29 mL/min: 5mg q48h; CrCl < 10 mL/min: CONTRAINDICATED
entries.pregnancy_category: B (Second-generation antihistamine of choice in pregnancy)

entries.ip_title: Levocetirizine Dihydrochloride IP / Levocetirizine Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Take once daily in evening with water.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: CrCl 30-49 mL/min: 2.5mg q48h; CrCl < 10 mL/min: CONTRAINDICATED
contraindications: End-stage renal disease (CrCl < 10 mL/min) or hemodialysis

entries.ip_title: Alprazolam IP / Alprazolam Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: High dependence and abuse potential. Limit to short-term crisis management of severe panic/anxiety. Do not combine with alcohol or opioids (respiratory depression).
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Caution in renal impairment; clearance decreased in elderly/cirrhosis

entries.ip_title: Calcium Gluconate Injection IP (10% w/v)
entries.default_dose: 10 mL (10% solution) IV slowly over 10 minutes
entries.default_instructions: Cardioprotection in severe hyperkalemia (membrane stabilization, does NOT lower K+ level) and severe hypocalcemic tetany. Infuse slowly with continuous ECG monitoring. NEVER push rapidly (cardiac arrest). Extravasation causes tissue necrosis.
entries.max_daily_dose: Titrated to ECG normalization (narrowing of QRS)
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment in acute hyperkalemic emergency

entries.ip_title: Potassium Chloride Injection IP / Potassium Chloride Oral Solution IP
entries.default_dose: 20 - 40 mEq diluted in 500-1000 mL IV fluid (or 15 mL syrup oral BD)
entries.default_instructions: HIGH ALERT MEDICATION: NEVER, UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES, ADMINISTER UNDILUTED AS IV PUSH OR BOLUS (LETHAL CARDIAC ARREST). Maximum peripheral IV concentration: 40 mEq/L; max infusion rate: 10-20 mEq/hr under continuous cardiac telemetry.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Use extreme caution in renal failure / oliguria (high risk of hyperkalemia)

entries.ip_title: Tranexamic Acid IP / Tranexamic Acid Injection IP / Tablets IP
entries.default_instructions: Antifibrinolytic hemostatic agent. Give slow IV push over 10 minutes (rapid injection causes hypotension). In major trauma (CRASH-2 protocol), 1g IV within 3 hours followed by 1g infusion over 8 hours.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Serum Cr 1.4-2.8 mg/dL: 10 mg/kg BD; Cr 2.8-5.7 mg/dL: 10 mg/kg OD; Cr > 5.7 mg/dL: 5 mg/kg OD
contraindications: Active thromboembolic disease (DVT, PE, cerebral thrombosis)
entries.pregnancy_category: B (Standard WOMAN-trial protocol for postpartum hemorrhage)

entries.ip_title: Oxytocin Injection IP
entries.default_dose: 10 IU IM STAT post-delivery / 20 IU in 500 mL RL at 125 mL/hr
entries.default_duration: Active management of third stage of labor (AMTSL) / PPH
entries.default_instructions: Store refrigerated at 2-8 deg C. Active management of third stage of labor: 10 IU IM immediately after delivery of anterior shoulder or baby. For PPH: 20-40 IU in 1000 mL RL IV infusion. Do NOT give rapid undiluted IV bolus (causes sudden hypotension and reflex tachycardia).
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment required
contraindications: Fetal distress when delivery is not imminent
entries.pregnancy_category: X (Elective use contraindicated prior to fetal maturity)

entries.ip_title: Oral Rehydration Salts IP (WHO Formulation)
entries.therapeutic_category: Solutions Correcting Water, Electrolyte Disturbances and Acid-Base

strengths: 20.5 g sachet for 1 Liter water (Reduced osmolarity 245 mOsm/L)

entries.default_dose: 1 Liter prepared fresh daily; drink 200-400 mL after each loose stool
entries.default_instructions: Dissolve entire contents of one sachet in EXACTLY 1 Liter of clean drinking water. Do not boil solution after preparation. Discard unused portion after 24 hours. In infants, give frequent spoonfuls.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: Caution in severe renal failure with hyperkalemia
contraindications: Severe hypovolemic shock (requires immediate IV crystalloid)

entries.ip_title: Folic Acid IP / Folic Acid Tablets IP
entries.default_duration: Periconceptional (3 months prior and 1st trimester) or ongoing in anemia
entries.default_instructions: Crucial for prevention of neural tube defects (spina bifida/anencephaly). Take daily.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment required
contraindications: Undiagnosed megaloblastic anemia (must rule out Vitamin B12 deficiency; folate alone precipitates subacute combined degeneration of spinal cord)

entries.ip_title: Ferrous Ascorbate and Folic Acid Tablets

strengths: 100 mg Elemental Iron + 1.5 mg Folic Acid
30 mg Elemental Iron + 500 mcg Folic Acid / 5 mL

entries.default_instructions: Take after food or with vitamin C juice. Avoid tea, coffee, milk, or calcium tablets within 2 hours. Warn patient that stools will turn black.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: No adjustment required
entries.pregnancy_category: A (Standard national anemia mukt bharat guideline)

entries.ip_title: Cholecalciferol IP / Cholecalciferol Granules IP
entries.default_dose: 60,000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then 60,000 IU monthly
entries.default_instructions: Fat-soluble vitamin: dissolve granules in a glass of warm milk or take capsule with a fatty meal to maximize absorption.
entries.renal_dose_adjustment: In severe CKD (eGFR < 30), inactive D3 has impaired 1-alpha-hydroxylation; prefer Calcitriol

order_sets.name: Acute Coronary Syndrome / STEMI Protocol
order_sets.description: Standardized acute emergency resuscitation and antiplatelet loading bundle for acute chest pain / acute myocardial infarction.

items.title: Aspirin 325 mg PO STAT
items.instructions: Chew and swallow tablet immediately for rapid antiplatelet activation.

items.title: Clopidogrel 300 mg PO STAT
items.instructions: Loading dose for dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT).

items.title: Atorvastatin 80 mg PO STAT
items.instructions: High-intensity statin plaque stabilization therapy.

items.title: Sublingual Nitroglycerin 0.5 mg SL q5min PRN
items.instructions: Dissolve under tongue. Hold if SBP < 90 mmHg or suspected right ventricular infarct.

items.title: Serum Troponin I STAT and repeat at 3 hours
items.instructions: High-sensitivity cardiac troponin biomarker.

items.title: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram (ECG) STAT
items.instructions: Immediate 10-minute door-to-ECG acquisition. Check reciprocal changes.

order_sets.name: Surviving Sepsis Campaign Hour-1 Bundle
order_sets.description: Immediate empirical resuscitation and broad-spectrum antimicrobial bundle for severe sepsis and septic shock.
order_sets.evidence_grade: Strong Recommendation, High Quality Evidence (Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2021)

items.title: Blood Cultures x 2 Sets STAT before antibiotics
items.instructions: Draw from two distinct venipuncture sites with aseptic technique before starting antibiotics.

items.title: Serum Lactate STAT and repeat in 2-4 hours
items.instructions: Stratify tissue hypoperfusion. If lactate > 2 mmol/L, trigger aggressive monitoring.

items.title: Piperacillin / Tazobactam 4.5 g IV STAT
items.instructions: Infuse over 30 minutes (or 3-hour extended infusion). First dose must be given within 1 hour.

items.title: 0.9% Normal Saline 30 mL/kg IV Bolus STAT
items.instructions: Rapid crystalloid resuscitation for hypotension or lactate >= 4 mmol/L.

items.title: Norepinephrine IV Infusion (if MAP < 65 mmHg post-fluids)
items.instructions: Vasopressor of choice in septic shock. Infuse via central venous catheter with syringe pump.

order_sets.name: Acute Decompensated Heart Failure Protocol
order_sets.description: Standardized inpatient volume offloading and neurohormonal management protocol.
order_sets.evidence_grade: Class I, Level B (ESC / HFSA Guidelines)

items.title: Furosemide 40 mg - 80 mg IV STAT
items.instructions: Slow IV bolus over 2 minutes. Match or double chronic outpatient oral dose.

items.title: Strict Fluid Restriction (1.5 L/24h) and Low Sodium Diet (< 2g/day)
items.instructions: Post bedside fluid restriction sign. Record all IV and oral fluids.

items.title: Strict Intake & Output Charting and Daily Weights in AM
items.instructions: Weigh patient on same scale after first morning void. Notify team if weight +/- 1.5 kg.

items.title: Renal Panel (Serum Creatinine, BUN, Potassium, Sodium) Daily
items.instructions: Monitor for diuretic-induced hypokalemia and worsening renal function.

order_sets.name: Community-Acquired Pneumonia (CAP) Inpatient Protocol
order_sets.description: Standardized inpatient ward antimicrobial regimen and respiratory support protocol for CAP.
order_sets.evidence_grade: Strong Recommendation, High Quality Evidence (ATS/IDSA Guidelines)

items.title: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV OD
items.instructions: Infuse in 100 mL Normal Saline over 30 minutes. Do NOT mix with calcium-containing fluids.

items.title: Azithromycin 500 mg PO/IV OD
items.instructions: Atypical pathogen coverage. Take 1 hour before or 2 hours after meals.

items.title: Paracetamol 650 mg PO TDS PRN for fever > 100.4 F
items.instructions: Antipyretic as needed. Minimum 4 hours between doses.

items.title: Sputum Gram Stain & Culture and Complete Blood Count (CBC)
items.instructions: Collect deep expectorated morning sputum before antibiotic administration if feasible.

items.title: Chest X-Ray PA/AP View
items.instructions: Assess lobar consolidation, air bronchograms, or parapneumonic effusion.

order_sets.name: Diabetic Ketoacidosis & Inpatient Glycemic Protocol
order_sets.description: Standardized IV regular insulin infusion, fluid rehydration, and potassium monitoring for severe hyperglycemic emergencies.
order_sets.evidence_grade: Class I, Level A (ADA / RSSDI Guidelines)

items.title: 0.9% Normal Saline 1000 mL IV Infusion over 1 hour
items.instructions: Initial fluid expansion in DKA. Reassess hydration and switch to 0.45% NS if serum Na is normal/high.

items.title: Human Regular Insulin IV Infusion (0.1 units/kg/hr)
items.instructions: Mix 50 IU Regular Insulin in 50 mL 0.9% NS (1 unit/mL). Run via syringe infusion pump. Target BG decline 50-75 mg/dL/hr.

items.title: Capillary Blood Glucose (CBG) Monitoring Hourly
items.instructions: Check bedside point-of-care glucometer hourly. Notify physician if BG < 200 mg/dL to add 5% Dextrose.

items.title: Serum Electrolytes (Potassium, Sodium, Bicarbonate, Anion Gap) q2-4h
items.instructions: Maintain serum K+ between 4.0 - 5.0 mEq/L. Add 20-30 mEq KCl per liter of IV fluid once K+ < 5.2 mEq/L.

order_sets.name: Post-Operative Standard Care & VTE Prophylaxis Protocol
order_sets.description: Standardized post-operative analgesia, antiemetics, venous thromboembolism prophylaxis, and wound monitoring.
order_sets.evidence_grade: Class I, Level A (ERAS / ACCP Guidelines)

items.title: Enoxaparin 40 mg SC OD (VTE Prophylaxis)
items.instructions: Inject subcutaneously in anterolateral abdominal wall. Start 6-12 hours post-op after surgical hemostasis verified.

items.title: Pantoprazole 40 mg IV OD (Stress Ulcer Prophylaxis)
items.instructions: Slow IV injection over 2 minutes in morning.

items.title: Ondansetron 4 mg IV TDS PRN for nausea/vomiting
items.instructions: Post-operative nausea and vomiting (PONV) control.

items.title: Paracetamol 1000 mg IV TDS Scheduled (Multimodal Analgesia)
items.instructions: Infuse IV over 15 minutes. Foundation of opioid-sparing multimodal postoperative analgesia.

items.title: Vitals q4h, Surgical Dressing Inspection, Incentive Spirometry q1h while awake
items.instructions: Check for wound strike-through, hematoma, urine output >= 0.5 mL/kg/hr.

order_sets.name: Acute Exacerbation of COPD / Severe Asthma Protocol
order_sets.description: Standardized bronchodilator nebulization, systemic corticosteroids, controlled oxygen, and non-invasive ventilation screening.
order_sets.evidence_grade: Class I, Level A (GOLD / GINA Guidelines)

items.title: Salbutamol 2.5 mg + Ipratropium 500 mcg Nebulization STAT and q4h
items.instructions: Nebulize with compressed air (or oxygen if hypoxic, target SpO2 88-92% in chronic hypercapnia).

items.title: Hydrocortisone 100 mg IV STAT / Prednisolone 40 mg PO OD
items.instructions: Short 5-day course of systemic corticosteroids; no tapering required for courses <= 5 days.

items.title: Doxycycline 100 mg PO BD (if purulent sputum)
items.instructions: First-line empirical antibacterial for Anthonisen Type 1/2 COPD exacerbation.

items.title: Continuous Pulse Oximetry and Controlled Oxygen Therapy (Target SpO2 88-92%)
items.instructions: Use Venturi mask (24% or 28%). Avoid high-flow unchecked oxygen to prevent hypercapnic respiratory arrest.

items.title: Arterial Blood Gas (ABG) Analysis STAT
items.instructions: Assess pH, PaCO2, PaO2, HCO3-. If pH < 7.35 and PaCO2 > 45 mmHg, trigger BiPAP evaluation.

order_sets.name: Acute Ischemic Stroke Inpatient Order Set
order_sets.description: Standardized acute ischemic stroke care, neurological monitoring, permissive hypertension limits, and dysphagia screening.
order_sets.evidence_grade: Class I, Level A (AHA/ASA Stroke Guidelines)

items.title: Non-Contrast Brain CT STAT
items.instructions: Emergency acquisition within 20 minutes of door arrival to exclude intracranial hemorrhage.

items.title: Strict NPO Until Formal Dysphagia Swallow Screen Performed
items.instructions: Prevents catastrophic aspiration pneumonia. No oral medications or water until cleared.

items.title: Aspirin 300 mg Suppository / Soluble PO (after CT excludes hemorrhage)
items.instructions: Give within 24-48 hours of stroke onset (hold for 24h if IV thrombolysis/alteplase administered).

items.title: Atorvastatin 80 mg PO / NG Daily at Bedtime
items.instructions: High-intensity statin neurovascular plaque stabilization.

items.title: Permissive Hypertension Management (Treat only if BP > 220/120 mmHg)
items.instructions: Do NOT lower BP acutely unless SBP > 220 or DBP > 120 mmHg (maintains ischemic penumbra perfusion).

order_sets.name: Acute Upper Gastrointestinal Bleeding Protocol
order_sets.description: Standardized high-dose IV proton pump inhibitor therapy, volume resuscitation, and emergent endoscopy preparation.
order_sets.evidence_grade: Class I, Level A (ACG / ESGE Guidelines)

items.title: Pantoprazole 80 mg IV Bolus STAT, followed by 8 mg/hr continuous infusion
items.instructions: Maintains intragastric pH > 6 to stabilize fibrin clot over bleeding ulcer base.

items.title: Tranexamic Acid 1000 mg IV STAT
items.instructions: Slow IV injection over 10 minutes.

items.title: Type & Crossmatch 2-4 Units Packed Red Blood Cells (PRBC) STAT
items.instructions: Blood bank emergency priority. Transfuse to maintain Hemoglobin >= 7-8 g/dL (restrictive transfusion threshold).

items.title: 0.9% Normal Saline IV Infusion (Wide-Bore 16G/18G PIV x 2)
items.instructions: Establish two large-bore peripheral IV lines immediately. Resuscitate hemodynamics before endoscopy.

order_sets.name: General Inpatient Admission Routine Order Set
order_sets.description: Standardized inpatient admission baseline orders covering vitals, DVT prophylaxis, gastroprotection, and diet.

items.title: Vital Signs Monitoring (BP, Pulse, RR, SpO2, Temp) q4h
items.instructions: Record NEWS2 score. Notify provider if SBP < 90 or > 180, HR < 50 or > 110, SpO2 < 92%.

items.title: Pantoprazole 40 mg PO OD before breakfast
items.instructions: Inpatient gastroprotection.

items.title: Admission Bloods: CBC, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, Urinalysis
items.instructions: Baseline organ function and hematology profile.

items.title: Regular Hospital Diet / Diabetic Diet as appropriate
items.instructions: Low sodium (< 2g) if hypertensive; diabetic diet if glycemic disorder.
